summary.plain: A neutrino experiment at the ISIS particle accelerator in England, running from 1990 to 2001. A tank of liquid holding light sensors sat 18 metres from where the beam stopped, watching for neutrinos changing type on the way. It found no such change and helped test a puzzling result from a similar experiment in the United States.
summary.technical: Liquid-scintillator calorimeter (56 t, 65 m^3 active volume) at the ISIS spallation neutron source, Rutherford Appleton Laboratory, 17.7 m from the beam-stop target at 100 degrees to the proton beam. Ran as KARMEN 1 from 1990 and, after an outer-veto upgrade in 1996, as KARMEN 2 from February 1997 to March 2001, setting limits on nu_e disappearance and on nu_mu_bar -> nu_e_bar appearance that excluded much of the LSND-favoured oscillation parameter space.
